RSS Chief Mohan Bhagwat Visits UK, Meets Hindu Groups

Rashtriya Swayamsevak Sangh (RSS) chief Mohan Bhagwat has arrived in London as part of the organization's global outreach program, which coincides with its centenary year. His visit follows stops in the United States and Canada. In the UK, over 100 Hindu groups welcomed Bhagwat. A British Member of Parliament of Indian origin expressed pleasure in listening to his thoughts and ideas. Bhagwat is expected to address the Indian diaspora in London over the weekend.
